items.domain: Sharing the road with vulnerable users and large vehicles
items.stem: An approaching emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights. What does the stated rule require?

options.text: Promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and remain stopped until it passes ahead
options.rationale: Option A is correct. When an approaching police or emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights, promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and stay stopped until it passes ahead.

options.text: Accelerate ahead of it
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. When an approaching police or emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights, promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and stay stopped until it passes ahead.

options.text: Stop in the center of the intersection regardless of position
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. When an approaching police or emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights, promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and stay stopped until it passes ahead.

options.text: Follow closely behind it
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. When an approaching police or emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights, promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and stay stopped until it passes ahead.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct. When an approaching police or emergency vehicle uses a siren or flashing red or blue lights, promptly pull to the right-side curb or road edge, stop and stay stopped until it passes ahead.

options.text: With traffic flow

options.text: Only toward the nearest intersection
options.rationale: This alternative does not match the cited rule. Bicyclists have driver-like road rights and must travel with traffic flow.

items.correct_rationale: Option C is correct. Bicyclists have driver-like road rights and must travel with traffic flow.
